en: Colorized view over a calm blue bay framed by dark green foliage and hills. In the foreground, a tiny islet holds a white church with a red-tiled roof and a small pier. Further back, another rocky islet with tall trees and buildings rises from the water. Mountains form the distant background. Handwritten text runs along the bottom and right edges, and printed captions appear near the lower edge.
